title: Environments
intro: Where the server connects when someone tries a contract: an HTTP base URL, a Kafka cluster or a read-only PostgreSQL database, per system. Administrators curate the list; passwords are stored encrypted and never shown again.
emptyNoSystems: Create a system first — every environment belongs to one

field.jdbcHint: jdbc:postgresql://host:port/db — parameters limited to ssl, sslmode, currentSchema, ApplicationName. Use a read-only role.
